example.translationZh: 印刷机的发明是人类历史上的一个转折点。

definitionEn: n. a dish made by folding a piece of pastry over a filling
definitionZh: n. 翻倒, 翻转, 半圆酥饼, 营业额, 流通, 周转\na. 可翻转的

example.text: She bought a warm apple turnover from the bakery for breakfast.
example.translationZh: 她从面包店买了一个热苹果酥饼当早餐。

definitionEn: v. be a tutor to someone; give individual instruction\nv. act as a guardian to someone
definitionZh: n. 家庭教师, 导师, 助教, 监护人\nvt. 当...的教师, 教, 指导, 约束, 克制\nvi. 当家庭教师, 受家庭教师的指导

example.text: She hired a private tutor to help her son with math.
example.translationZh: 她聘请了一位私人家庭教师来辅导她儿子的数学。

definitionEn: n. a session of intensive tuition given by a tutor to an individual or to a small number of students\na. of or relating to tutors or tutoring
definitionZh: n. 个别指导, 论文, 学习指南, 指导手册\na. 个别指导的, 家庭教师的, 辅导的\n[计] 教程

example.text: The professor offers a weekly tutorial to help students with difficult concepts.
example.translationZh: 教授每周提供一次辅导，帮助学生理解难点概念。

definitionEn: n broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects\nn an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen
definitionZh: 电视\n[计] 电视, 转移向量

example.text: We usually watch TV together after dinner.
example.translationZh: 我们通常晚饭后一起看电视。

definitionEn: n a hand tool for holding consisting of a compound lever for grasping
definitionZh: n. 镊子

example.text: She used a pair of tweezers to pluck the stray eyebrow hair.
example.translationZh: 她用一把镊子拔掉了那根杂乱的眉毛。

definitionEn: v. branch out in a twiglike manner
definitionZh: n. 小枝, 细枝\nv. 懂得, 了解

example.text: The bird landed on a tiny twig near the top of the tree.
example.translationZh: 那只鸟落在靠近树顶的一根细小的树枝上。

definitionEn: n. the time of day immediately following sunset\nn. the diffused light from the sky when the sun is below the horizon but its rays are refracted by the atmosphere of the earth\nn. a condition of decline following successes
definitionZh: n. 暮光, 曙光, 黎明, 黄昏, 微光, 朦胧状态\na. 微明的

example.text: The old lighthouse stood silent in the twilight, casting a faint glow over the quiet harbor.
example.translationZh: 古老的灯塔在暮色中静静矗立，向宁静的港湾洒下一抹微光。

definitionEn: n. a rapid change in brightness; a brief spark or flash\nv. emit or reflect light in a flickering manner
definitionZh: n. 闪烁, 闪耀, 瞬息\nvi. 闪烁\nvt. 使闪耀

example.text: The stars began to twinkle as the night grew darker.
example.translationZh: 随着夜色渐深，星星开始闪烁。

phrase.translationZh: 眼中的光芒；闪烁的眼神

definitionEn:
n. a jerky pulling movement
n. social dancing in which couples vigorously twist their hips and arms in time to the music; was popular in the 1960s
n. turning or twisting around (in place)
v. turn in the opposite direction
definitionZh: n. 一扭, 扭曲, 曲折, 歪曲, 螺旋状, 新手法\nvt. 拧, 扭, 捻, 编织, 使扭转, 缠绕, 盘绕, 歪曲, 使转动, 使苦恼, 使混乱, 使旋转\nvi. 转向, 弯曲, 缠绕, 扭动, 呈螺旋形

example.text: The mountain road twists and turns for miles before reaching the village.
example.translationZh: 这条山路蜿蜒曲折好几英里才到达村庄。

definitionEn:
n. a subdivision of a particular kind of thing
n. (biology) the taxonomic group whose characteristics are used to define the next higher taxon
n. printed characters
n. all of the tokens of the same symbol
definitionZh:
n. 类型, 样式, 典型, 榜样, 标志, 符号, 型, 式
vi. 打字
vt. 作为代表, 测定类型, 用打字机打
[计] 类型; 键入; DOS内部命令:在屏幕上显示指定文件的内容

example.text: This is a new type of smartphone that folds in half.
example.translationZh: 这是一种可以对折的新型智能手机。

definitionEn:
n a subdivision of a particular kind of thing
n a person of a specified kind (usually with many eccentricities)
n (biology) the taxonomic group whose characteristics are used to define the next higher taxon
n printed characters
n all of the tokens of the same symbol
n a small metal block bearing a raised character on one end; produces a printed character when inked and pressed on paper
v write by means of a keyboard with types
v identify as belonging to a certain type
definitionZh: v. 打字（type的第三人称单数形式）

example.text: There are many different types of birds in this forest.
example.translationZh: 这片森林里有许多不同类型的鸟。

definitionEn: n. a tropical cyclone occurring in the western Pacific or Indian oceans
definitionZh: n. 台风

example.text: The coastal city was evacuated after a typhoon warning was issued.
example.translationZh: 发布台风警报后，这座沿海城市进行了人员疏散。

definitionEn: a. exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category\ns. conforming to a type
definitionZh: a. 典型的, 象征性的\n[医] 典型的

example.text: This painting is a typical example of the artist's early style.
example.translationZh: 这幅画是这位艺术家早期风格的一个典型例子。

definitionEn: s marked by unjust severity or arbitrary behavior\ns characteristic of an absolute ruler or absolute rule; having absolute sovereignty
definitionZh: a. 暴虐的, 暴君的, 残暴的

example.text: The country suffered for decades under a tyrannical regime that silenced all opposition.
example.translationZh: 这个国家在一个压制一切反对声音的暴虐政权下遭受了数十年的苦难。

definitionEn: n a port in southern Lebanon on the Mediterranean Sea; formerly a major Phoenician seaport famous for silks\nn hoop that covers a wheel
definitionZh: n. 轮胎\nvt. 装轮胎于

example.text: He kept a spare tyre in the boot in case of a puncture.
example.translationZh: 他在后备箱里放了一个备用轮胎，以防爆胎。

definitionEn: a. displeasing to the senses
definitionZh: a. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的\nn. 丑陋的人(或物)

example.text: Nobody wanted to admit the ugly truth about the scandal.
example.translationZh: 没有人愿意承认那桩丑闻背后丑陋的真相。

definitionEn: r. as the end result of a succession or process
definitionZh: adv. 最后, 最终\n[法] 最后, 终究, 总之

example.text: The board is ultimately responsible for the company's decisions.
example.translationZh: 董事会对公司的决策负有最终责任。

definitionEn: n. a final peremptory demand
definitionZh: n. 最后通牒, 基本原理\n[法] 最后通牒, 哀的美敦书, 最后结论

example.text: The union issued an ultimatum to the company, demanding a pay raise within a week or a strike would follow.
example.translationZh: 工会向公司发出最后通牒，要求在一周内加薪，否则将举行罢工。

definitionEn: n. radiation lying in the ultraviolet range; wave lengths shorter than light but longer than X rays\ns. having or employing wavelengths shorter than light but longer than X-rays; lying outside the visible spectrum at its violet end
definitionZh: a. 紫外线的\n[化] 紫外线的; 紫外线

example.text: Prolonged exposure to ultraviolet light can damage your skin.
example.translationZh: 长时间暴露在紫外线下会损伤皮肤。

definitionEn: s in complete agreement\ns acting together as a single undiversified whole
definitionZh: a. 意见一致的, 无异议的

example.text: After hours of discussion, the committee reached a unanimous decision on the new budget.
example.translationZh: 经过数小时的讨论，委员会就新预算达成了一致决定。

definitionEn: a. conducive to or feeling mental discomfort\na. providing or experiencing physical discomfort
definitionZh: a. 不舒服的, 不自在的, 不安的

example.text: She felt uncomfortable in the crowded room.
example.translationZh: 她在拥挤的房间里感到不舒服。

definitionEn: a. not conditional\ns. not contingent; not determined or influenced by someone or something else
definitionZh: a. 无条件的, 无限制的, 绝对的\n[经] 无条件的, 无保留的

example.text: A parent's unconditional love does not depend on a child's success.
example.translationZh: 父母无条件的爱不取决于孩子的成功。

definitionEn: a. not conscious; lacking awareness and the capacity for sensory perception as if asleep or dead\ns. without conscious volition\ns. (followed by `of') not knowing or perceiving
definitionZh: a. 未意识到的, 无意识的, 无知觉的\n[医] 人事不省的, 神志丧失的; 无意识的

example.text: She was completely unconscious of the fact that everyone in the room had stopped talking.
example.translationZh: 她完全没有意识到房间里所有人都已经停止了交谈。

definitionEn: a. not convincing
definitionZh: a. 不足以令人相信的

example.text: His explanation for being late was an unconvincing excuse that no one believed.
example.translationZh: 他迟到的解释是一个不能令人信服的借口，没有人相信。

phrase.translationZh: 一个不能令人信服的借口

definitionEn: n. an estimation that is too low; an estimate that is less than the true or actual value\nv. make too low an estimate of
definitionZh: n. 低估\nvt. 低估, 看轻

example.text: We underestimated the difficulty of the hike and ran out of water before reaching the summit.
example.translationZh: 我们低估了这次徒步的难度，还没到达山顶水就喝完了。

definitionEn: n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
definitionZh: n. 大学本科生, 大学肄业生\na. 大学生的

example.text: She is studying for an undergraduate degree in biology.
example.translationZh: 她正在攻读生物学本科学位。

definitionEn: n. a secret group organized to overthrow a government or occupation force\nr. in or into hiding or secret operation\nr. beneath the surface of the earth
definitionZh: n. 地下, 地铁, 地道, 秘密活动\na. 地下的, 秘密的\nadv. 在地下, 秘密地

example.text: After the scandal broke, the journalist went underground to avoid questioning.
example.translationZh: 丑闻曝光后，那名记者转入地下以躲避质询。

definitionEn: v. draw a line or lines underneath to call attention to
definitionZh: vt. 在...下面划线, 作...的衬里, 强调\nn. 下划线, 图下说明文字\n[计] 加下划线; 下划线

example.text: Please underline the word to show that it is important.
example.translationZh: 请在这个词下面划线，以表示它很重要。

definitionEn: s. located beneath or below
definitionZh: a. 在下面的\n[经] 优先的, 基础的, 放在下面的

example.text: The doctor investigated the underlying cause of the patient's symptoms.
example.translationZh: 医生调查了患者症状的根本原因。

definitionEn: v destroy property or hinder normal operations\nv hollow out as if making a cave or opening
definitionZh: vt. 在...下面挖, 渐渐破坏, 暗地里破坏\n[法] 暗中破坏, 以阴谋中伤伤害

example.text: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
example.translationZh: 不断的批评会削弱孩子的自信心。

definitionEn: r. on the lower or downward side; on the underside of\nr. under or below an object or a surface; at a lower place or level; directly beneath
definitionZh: adv. 在下面\nprep. 在...的下面

example.text: The cat is sleeping underneath the table.
example.translationZh: 猫正在桌子下面睡觉。

definitionEn: n. the cognitive condition of someone who understands\ns. characterized by understanding based on comprehension and discernment and empathy
definitionZh: n. 理解, 谅解\n[法] 协商, 协议, 谅解

example.text: After hours of discussion, the two sides finally reached an understanding.
example.translationZh: 经过几个小时的讨论，双方终于达成了谅解。

definitionEn: v. guarantee financial support of
definitionZh: vt. 签名于下, 给...保险\nvi. 经营保险业

example.text: The company agreed to underwrite the new policy after reviewing the risk.
example.translationZh: 公司在评估风险后同意承保这份新保单。

definitionEn: v. cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect\nv. cause the ruin or downfall of
definitionZh: vt. 解开, 取消, 破坏, 毁灭, 扰乱\nvi. 松开\n[计] 撤消

example.text: The company issued a public apology to undo the damage caused by the misleading advertisement.
example.translationZh: 公司发表了公开道歉，以挽回误导性广告造成的损害。

definitionEn: r. without doubt; certainly
definitionZh: adv. 无疑, 必定, 确实地

example.text: She is undoubtedly the best candidate for the job.
example.translationZh: 她无疑是这份工作的最佳人选。

definitionEn: a. not yet payable\na. not appropriate or proper (or even legal) in the circumstances\ns. lacking justification or authorization
definitionZh: a. 不适当的, 过度的, 未到期的\n[经] 未到(支付)期的

example.text: The lawyer claimed that his client had signed the contract under undue influence.
example.translationZh: 律师声称他的当事人是在不当影响下签署了那份合同。

definitionEn: a. lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance\ns. relating to bodily unease that causes discomfort
definitionZh: a. 心神不安的, 不自在的, 不稳定的, 不舒服的

example.text: She felt uneasy about walking home alone after dark.
example.translationZh: 她对于天黑后独自步行回家感到不安。
